title: The Cheap Hardware Wallet
intro: A sponsored post in your feed: a hardware wallet at 80% off.
You have been meaning to buy one to keep your coins offline.

msg.text: Pay by bank transfer or crypto only

price.label: Price far too low
price.lens: 80% off a security product is unrealistic.
price.why: A real maker does not sell its own wallet at a fifth of the price. The cheap price is bait.

link.label: Look-alike shop
link.why: The real maker sells from its own site.

pay.label: Hard-to-reverse payment only
pay.lens: Bank transfer or crypto cannot be taken back.
pay.why: Scam shops avoid cards because a card payment can be disputed.

stock.label: "Only 12 left"
stock.why: Scarcity pushes you to buy before thinking.

ad.label: A paid ad
ad.why: Anyone can pay for an ad, so being an ad proves nothing either way.

handle.label: Shop-like handle
handle.why: A handle can be copied. Check the website.

name.label: Hedrio in the name
name.lens: The shop name says Hedrio Outlet.
name.why: Anyone can put a brand in a name. Check the site.

actions.label: Buy it before the sale ends
Check hedrio.app for the real price and where to buy

trap.title: Hedrio Vault Outlet
trap.ask: Pay €19 by bank transfer to reserve your wallet.

block_report.line: Reported. The fake shop was taken down before more people paid.

verify.line: The real site listed the wallet at full price and named its official shops. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You scrolled past safely. A report would protect the next buyer.

go_ahead.line: The €19 went to a stranger. No wallet ever arrived.

what_if.go_ahead: The real site would have shown the full price and a list of real shops.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the ad helps others.
what_if.ignore: Scrolling past was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: Buy wallets only from the maker's own site. A huge discount on a security product is a warning.

quick_check.q: An ad sells a hardware wallet at 80% off, payable only by bank transfer. What do you do?

options.text: Skip it. Buy from the maker's own site and report the ad

quick_check.explain: A too-low price and an irreversible payment are the signs. The maker's own site is the safe place.

hints.nudge: Would a real maker sell this for a fifth of the price?

rows.v: Lets you dispute the payment, a bank transfer does not
List their official shops on their own site
